preview: Sarah: Sounds good, Nicholas. Enjoy the B30 when it gets to you.

messages.text:
Nicholas, your B30 on Shop···· ships November 15. The Power K. is already set aside for it at our Tennessee warehouse. The B30 is the one part still to come in, and it's in the batch rolling out mid-November.

You can follow that batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking comes to your email as soon as it ships.
Before you go, one thing: back in October you ordered a second B30 and cancelled it the next day. What made you change your mind?
Waiting to see what the first one does
That makes sense. What would the first B30 need to show you, like hashrate, noise or power draw, before you'd order a second one?
That's fair, Nicholas. Thanks for telling me. Once your B30 is running, send me what the dashboard shows and I'll help you work out whether a second one makes sense.
Sounds good, Nicholas. Enjoy the B30 when it gets to you.
